description: Look up FreeSign envelopes by their stored document SHA-256. Returns up to 20 matching records, newest first, with evidence identifiers and their stored status (draft, otp_sent, signed, finalized, or expired). An unknown hash returns an empty matches array. Use the original PDF hash for a draft created through MCP from that hash. If a direct browser or older signing flow rewrote the PDF, use the hash of the normalized signing base shown by FreeSign. A match alone does not establish signature validity. This tool does not upload PDF bytes to FreeSign.
name: verify_document_hash
title: Verify document hash
